name: Think and Choice
detailed_description:
This is a casual board battle strategy game.

Thinking and decision-making, judgment and opportunity, you are the brain of the team, observing enemies, adjusting the team, planning actions, and commanding on the chessboard. You will seize the critical opportunity and defeat the strong enemy.

In this game, the damage caused by characters is divided into ordinary damage and attribute damage. The attributes that cause damage are mainly composed of classic mutual restraint of water, fire, and grass. Of course, there are also some special derivative attributes (such as ice), and the restraint attribute can cause more damage.

In the challenge mode, before entering the battle level, you have the opportunity to adjust your team and choose different gates to enter the battle. The choice of gates will affect the types and attributes of some enemies in the battle level, and may even lead to different environments. Choosing the door that is more advantageous to you can allow your team to leverage their strengths!
